note: DEFECT FIX, not new coverage — claims 0 lines. ParkBuilder.Build() used to call the editor-only BuildPlacedAsset (Mesh.CombineMeshes) for 5 mass-count categories (parklamp 5,111 / fountain 110 / playset 627 / slide 209 / monkeybar 208 placements), merging every placement of one FBX into a single Mesh. At playset's count against its real 175,772-vertex source FBX that produced a >4GB mesh -- Unity's own load-time warning 'Mesh playset_0 data size is too large (>4GB)' -- and parklamp (measured ~24.6M verts combined, ~1GB) was heading the same way. These 5 merged-mesh outputs (LampMeshes/FountainMeshes/PlaysetMeshes/SlideMeshes/MonkeyMeshes + their Mats) had ZERO renderer consumers anywhere in unity/Assets -- grepped before and after -- because City/ParkRenderer.cs's PlaceScatter (already in this project, already correct, already filed under its own parks-wave port unit) independently chunk-instances these exact 5 categories straight from the same ParkBuilder.Lamps/Fountains/PlaysetSpots/SlideSpots/MonkeySpots Item lists via ChunkedInstancer.Place + Graphics.RenderMeshInstanced -- the same instanced path src/parks.js's inst()/instProp() and ParkRenderer's own tree scatter use. So the fix is deletion: the 5 BuildPlacedAsset call sites (old ParkBuilder.cs:403-407) and their now-unused fields are removed; nothing was re-ported because the real port of those lines already lived in ParkRenderer.cs. The 3 flower categories (flower_gazania/flower_ursinia/celandine_01, ~325 placements each off a 974-bed total) are left as merged CombineMeshes output -- measured 2.8M-6.8M combined verts, no warning before or after, and ParkRenderer.AttachCombined is their only consumer. CityPropsProbe.cs (Editor/Probes, unowned this pass) was updated in the same commit to stop reading the removed fields. Verified via BuildPlayableScene.Run rebake: 'data size is too large' warnings 2 -> 0; PARKS line counts unchanged (parks=563 lamps=5111 playset=627 slide=209 monkey=208 beds=974); PARKRENDER batches=583 drawCalls=583 instances=11805 identical before/after (ParkRenderer's own rendering path was never touched).
